original_test_intent: Validate each Type 42 Handle as a well-formed table-local WORD unique in the current SMBIOS table and associated with the intended management interface, without incorrectly requiring the same numeric value after reboot.
original_method: Decode raw offset 02h with correct byte order, validate header/length and complete-table uniqueness, bind the record to controller/interface content, then after reboot revalidate uniqueness and semantic continuity while allowing legitimate handle renumbering.
manual_activity: A user defines controller association/reassignment policy and approves reboot; raw uniqueness and semantic continuity checks are automated.
required_inputs: Policy distinguishing valid handle reassignment from identity change
Complete raw SMBIOS table with header/length parser
safety_requirements: Use handles only as read-only identifiers; never target a write/reset from this case.
Check uniqueness across the complete table instance, not just Type 42.
Do not fail solely on cross-boot numeric change; compare stable record content/interface identity.
Stop on management health loss; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode raw handle, verify current-table uniqueness/validity and controller association, then compare semantic identity and renewed uniqueness across reboot.
Report duplicate, malformed, unresolvable or identity-changing records without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve interface identity and handle-reassignment policy plus reboot recovery.
Adjudicate legitimate firmware table reorderings and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The selector is overbroad and cannot prove offset-02h WORD, table-wide uniqueness or management-interface ownership.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive the complete raw table and emit Type 42 raw handle, uniqueness result, stable content/interface fingerprint and pre/post reassignment analysis.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Handle scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; exact cross-boot numeric equality is not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: TABLE-LOCAL UNIQUE HANDLE WITH SEMANTIC CONTINUITY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode each handle from raw header, validate full-table uniqueness, build a content/interface identity independent of the handle number and compare both table instances across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS entry-point, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and management-inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS structure header Handle semantics and Type 42 definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds byte-accurate decoding, full-table uniqueness and avoids false cross-boot stability assumptions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects duplicates and identity swaps while accepting legitimate table-local renumbering.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected controller associations and reassignment policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Handle equality is not a stable hardware identity; content and approved interface mapping must anchor comparisons.

project_override_considerations: Projects may require exact handle stability only if their firmware contract explicitly guarantees it; the Master review treats handles as table-local and records semantic continuity separately.
expected_evidence: Approved Type 42 controller mapping and reassignment policy
Complete pre/post raw SMBIOS tables and entry-point versions
Per-table raw handles with uniqueness/validity report
Content/interface identity mapping and explicit renumbering-versus-swap analysis

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Handle is a defined header WORD; table-local rather than permanent identity semantics preserve the field's actual role.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Full-table uniqueness and semantic continuity are fully automatable after mapping/policy inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw offset, full-table uniqueness and semantic identity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains the no-false-handle-stability rule while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates interface/reassignment/reboot inputs and formal verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Avoids both accepting duplicate handles and falsely failing valid firmware table renumbering after reboot.
independent_technical_reasoning: A SMBIOS handle is an identifier scoped to one table instance; its invariant is uniqueness and correct record association, while cross-boot identity must be established from content/context.
